title: New Made in Abyss Movie Confirms Streaming Release Platform With New Trailer – Watch
content:
Made in Abyss is coming back to screens with a brand new movie , and has now confirmed a streaming release that fans will be able to look forward to next year. Akihito Tsukushi’s Made in Abyss has been a monumental success over the past decade thanks to the fact that the dark series ended up reaching a whole new level of popularity with its TV anime adaptation. That anime went on for multiple seasons, and has even had a few feature film releases under its belt. Now it’s coming back for more.

Made in Abyss has kicked off a whole new trilogy of feature films continuing the story from its previous entry, and Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery is the first major entry now working its way through theaters in Japan this Fall. Fans in international territories had been waiting for their chance to see the new movie in action too, and now it’s been confirmed that HIDIVE will be exclusively streaming the new film outside of Japan in 2027. Check out the new trailer for it below.

Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery Movie Confirms HIDIVE Streaming Release

Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery will be making its streaming debut with HIDIVE sometime next year, but a concrete release date has yet to be announced as of this time. The film will be having its North American premiere on December 5th as part of a special screening at Anime Frontier, and is the first in a new trilogy of films planned for the franchise with the second film now confirmed to be in the works. The main cast from the previous entries are confirmed to return too with Mariya Ise as Reg, Miyu Tomita as Riko, Shiori Izawa as Nanachi, and Misaki Kuno as Faputa.

Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery is directed by Masayuki Kojima for Kinema Citrus with Hideyuki Kurata handling the script for the films, Kazuchika Kise and Yuka Kuroda handling the character designs, and Kevin Penkin composing the music. The composer also contributed to the theme song for the film titled “Chain of the Abyss,” with Mori Calliope. Several new faces have been added to the voice cast for the coming trilogy as well with the first of this new group making their debut in the new film.

What’s Next for Made in Abyss ?

New additions joining the cast for Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery include Sumire Morohoshi as Tepaste, Takanori Hoshino as Cravagli, Nana Mizuki as Srajo, Akeno Watanabe as Nishagora, Shunsuke Takeuchi as Yataramar, Nao Toyama as Sherumi, and Yume Miyamoto as Menae. Given that this is the first of a newly planned trilogy, it’s going to have a lot for fans to dig into. So you should probably take the time to go back and check out the first two seasons of the TV series now streaming with HIDIVE in the meantime.

Made in Abyss also continued with a feature film entry, Dawn of the Deep Soul , and you’ll want to be sure to catch up with everything to make sure you can jump back into it. Made in Abyss doesn’t really hold anyone’s hand as Riko and Reg descend further into the titular Abyss, and it’s not going to be holding back when it hits. Are you excited to see the new Made in Abyss movie soon? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: SSS-Class Revival Hunter New Trailer Previews Ending Theme Song by THE SPELLBOUND x BOOM BOOM SATELLITES
content:
SSS-Class Revival Hunter anime has released a new trailer featuring additional footage and a preview of its ending theme song “Fading” performed by THE SPELLBOUND × BOOM BOOM SATELLITES.

The anime was previously announced for January 2027, with Crunchyroll set to stream it.

THE SPELLBOUND x BOOM BOOM SATELLITES commented on the ending theme:

“With the opening guitar riff, we wanted to capture the exhilarating feeling of breaking through even a predetermined fate. Through the melody and upbeat electronic sound, we wanted to express the refreshing sensation of continuing to rise. We poured into this song the energetic impulse of continuing to change both yourself and the world the more you live. We hope it can boost the world of SSS-Class Revival Hunter.”

The main voice cast includes Takeo Otsuka as Kim Gongja and Satoshi Hino as the Sword Emperor. You can see the full cast below.

• Takeo Otsuka as Kim Gongja

• Satoshi Hino as Sword Emperor

• Toshiki Masuda as Flame Emperor

• Megumi Han as Witch of the Black Dragon

• Sayaka Kinoshita as Paladin

• Risa Shimizu as Countess

• Makoto Furukawa as Poisonous Viper

• Natsumi Fujiwara as Inquisitor

• Yuka Iguchi as Master Alchemist

• Shunsuke Sakuya as Blade Saint

You can watch the new trailer below.

Hiroaki Sakurai, known for The Disastrous Life of Saiki K. , is directing the anime at STUDIO fu. Sayuri Oba is handling the scripts, while Takahiro Yoshimatsu is serving as character designer. Ryu Kawasaki and Tomoyuki Kono are in charge of the music.

SSS-Class Revival Hunter follows Kim Gongja, an F-rank Hunter who obtains an ability that allows him to return to 24 hours before his death. With the Sword Emperor, a former top Hunter who now follows him as a ghost, Gongja begins climbing through the Hunter ranks while repeatedly using death to alter his path.

Crunchyroll will stream SSS-Class Revival Hunter in North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS, the Indian Subcontinent, Indonesia, the Philippines, Malaysia and Singapore.

The original Korean webcomic by Shin Noah and illustrated by Bill K debuted in December 2020 and has released 154 episodes to date. An English-language edition is available through Tapas, though Kakao Entertainment is shutting Tapas down by the end of the year.

title: PlayStation 5 Reaches Over 100 Million Shipments
content:
The company had previously reported last week that it had shipped 97.9 million units as of September 30. Sony shipped an additional 2.1 million units since.

The company has now shipped 6.3 million units for the current fiscal year so far, with 2.6 million alone from this fiscal year's second quarter between July-September.

PS5 reached over 90 million shipments last February, and reached over 80 million shipments in August 2025. As of July 2021, Sony had sold over 10 million units of the PS5 worldwide since its launch, making the PS5 Sony 's fastest-selling console. Sony had sold over 20 million units of the PS5 worldwide as of June 2022. The PS5 had crossed 30 million units in sales in January 2023, and then crossed the 40 million mark in July 2023. It surpassed 50 million in sales in December 2023.

Sony raised the price of its PS5, PS5 Digital Edition, and PS5 Pro consoles, as well as its PlayStation Portal peripheral, beginning on April 2, due to "continued pressures in the global economic landscape." The company raised the price of the PlayStation Plus online gaming subscription service for new customers in select regions beginning on May 20.

Sony announced on July 1 that it is ending physical game disc production for all new games on PlayStation consoles starting in January 2028. All new game releases starting in that month will be digital only. This does not affect games that have already been released or that will ship prior to January 2028 as discs. The company cites this decision as an adaptation "to consumer trends as the general preference for digital media significantly outpaces physical discs."

The PS5 launched in the United States, Japan, Canada, Mexico, Australia, New Zealand, and South Korea on November 12, 2020. The console launched in most of the rest of the world on November 19, 2020. The PS5 got a new, smaller model intended to replace the old model throughout November to early December in 2023 in various territories.

The PlayStation 5 Pro console shipped in November 2024. The PS5 Pro features PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution, 120 FPS, advanced ray tracing, 2TB of SSD storage, upgraded GPU with "28% faster memory", and AI-driven upscaling to improve image clarity.

Sony released a new model for the PS5 Digital Edition in Japan that only has Japanese language support in November 2025. It is cheaper than the multi-language Digital Edition model, at 55,000 yen (about US$355). The current Digital Edition model for the PS5 sells at 72,980 yen (about US$471) in Japan.

title: Mashle Season 3 Confirms Crunchyroll Release Date With New Trailer – Watch
content:
Mashle: Magic and Muscles is gearing up for its highly anticipated return for a third season next year, and has now confirmed its release date ahead of its launch with Crunchyroll. Mashle: Magic and Muscles might not have been one of the most notable Shonen Jump releases when Hajime Komoto’s original manga series was active, but the series has found a whole new life in the last few years. And it’s about to be bigger than ever next year with both a TV anime and a new live-action movie now in the works.

MASHLE: MAGIC AND MUSCLES The Tri-Magicathlon Divine Visionary Final Exam Arc will be making its debut early next year as part of the Winter 2027 anime schedule , and it will be streaming exclusively with Crunchyroll when it hits on January 9th. To celebrate the confirmation of the release date, Crunchyroll has dropped a new trailer for the season that you can check out in action below showing off the best look at the coming episodes thus far.

Mashle Season 3 Confirms Crunchyroll Streaming Release Date

MASHLE: MAGIC AND MUSCLES The Tri-Magicathlon Divine Visionary Final Exam Arc will be making its debut on January 9th as part of the Winter 2027 anime schedule, and will be streaming exclusively with Crunchyroll outside of Japan . That’s also where you can catch up with everything that’s happened in the first two seasons of the series thus far, and that’s going to be necessary as this third season picks up in the midst of that final exam that ended the second season. It’s going to feature a mostly returning staff from the second season too.

Tomoya Tanaka is returning as director of MASHLE: MAGIC AND MUSCLES The Tri-Magicathlon Divine Visionary Final Exam Arc for A-1 Pictures with Yosuke Kuroda returning as series writer, Masaru Yokoyama composing the music, and Chiaki Furuzumi taking over as character designer . It’s also been revealed that its core cast is set to return to with Chiaki Kobayashi as Mash Burnedead, Kaito Ishikawa as Lance Crown, Reiji Kawashima as Finn Ames, Reina Ueda as Lemon Irvine, and Takuya Eguchi as Dot Barrett all set for their comebacks thus far.

What’s Next for Mashle in 2027?

Mashle: Magic and Muscles is set to have a huge return for the franchise with not only a third season of the TV anime coming next year, but it’s also got a new live-action feature film in the works as well. Surprising revealed to be in production, the new live-action Mashle movie is currently scheduled for a release in Japan on March 19th, and Warner Bros., Fuji TV, and Toho are overseeing the film with CREDEUS handling the production. But no international release plans have been announced as of the time of this writing.

It’s also been revealed that Mackenyu, who currently stars in Netflix’s One Piece live-action series as Roronoa Zoro, has been cast as the live-action Mash. The actor revealed that he’s spent three years training for the role , and that’s bound to end up with a fantastic final result. But we’ll be seeing it more in action likely next year once the anime is up and running. What are you hoping to see from Mashle ‘s big 2027 takeover? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Sells Over 5.2 Million Units to Become Nintendo's Fastest-Selling Switch 2 Game
content:
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake launched on November 5.

The remake adds traditional camera controls, motion controls, a proper jump button, and a roll dash action. Players can equip an item to the controller's ZR button, and switch between them in a pop-up menu. A new Threads of Time menu helps players recap the story and recognize the next objective. Unlike the original game, time passes in town. Players can now hum into the Switch 2's microphone or play a real-life ocarina to play music in-game. The remake adds dialogue and the new Hall of Fallen Foes, an area where players can view statues of enemies they have defeated and engage in rematches. There is also compatibility with the Zelda Notes function in the Nintendo Switch App.

The original The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time debuted for N64 in November 1998 in the U.S. and Japan, and in December 1998 in Europe and Australia. It is the fifth mainline game in The Legend of Zelda series, and it is the first game in the franchise to feature 3D graphics. The game has since received rereleases on various systems, including via two collection discs for Nintendo GameCube, the Virtual Console on Nintendo Wii, and the Nintendo Classics app on Nintendo Switch. The game got a remastered edition for Nintendo 3DS titled The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 3D in June 2011. The 3DS version, as well as one of the collection discs for GameCube, included a version of the game with different dungeons titled The Legend of Zelda : Master Quest , based on a Nintendo 64DD title.

The game got a manga adaptation by Akira Himekawa , who has also drawn manga of other games in the franchise , in 2000. Viz Media has released the manga in English.

The franchise 's live-action film will open April 30, 2027, a week earlier from its previously planned May 7, 2027 opening date. The May 7, 2027 opening date was itself a delay from the film's original March 26, 2027 opening date. Unlike most games in the series, the film has no subtitle.

title: South Park Teases Tweek x Craig Return in New Season 29 Episode First Look Trailer – Watch Now
content:
South Park Season 29 has been going back to its roots with all of its episodes so far, and the next episode is promising another return with the first look at a new Tweek and Craig episode coming our way. South Park might have made a big swing when it first made its debut with the reveal of its name change to “South America,” and has made even bigger swings in the episodes since , but it’s also made sure to return the focus of the episodes to each of the boys themselves.

South Park Season 29 has had a few adventures with the boys so far, but the next episode of the series is teasing a return to the fan favorite duo of Tweek and Craig as the two of them get involved with club sports. With the next episode of the season coming later today, Wednesday, November 11th, South Park has dropped the first look promo for the new episode that you can check out in action below.

South Park Season 29 Episode 5 Confirms Release Date & Time

South Park Season 29 Episode 5 is titled “We Be Clubbin’” and will be making its debut with Comedy Central on Wednesday, November 11th at 10PM ET/PT before being available to stream exclusively with Paramount+ the next day in the United States, Canada and Australia. Tweek and Craig has become one of the more popular late series changes that fans have loved to see add to the overall canon, and thankfully this season won’t be going by without a new update on how the two of them have been doing.

As for what’s happening with the duo in the episode itself, it’s titled “When club sports take over Craig’s afternoons and weekends, Tweek signs up to spend more time with him. Soon his whole family struggles to keep up.” It’s returning to the relationship dynamic between the two of them as Tweek misses out on Craig, and those usually result in some fun episodes when they are the full focus. Especially after it’s been such a long time since the series focused on the two of them on their own. Given all of the new changes to the show , bringing back a classic dynamic like this is a great sign.

What’s Next for South Park Season 29?

As for the rest of South Park Season 29, it’s quickly running through its final slate of previously scheduled episodes for the year. There’s only one episode left scheduled for the season as confirmed by Paramount releasing on Wednesday, November 25th. Part of the initial deal between Paramount and South Park series creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone was to release ten episodes a year over the next five years, but this only accounts for six of those episodes. That means there are still four potential episodes left unaccounted for.

This ended up resulting in the release of two new seasons last year with both South Park Season 27 and 28 running for five episodes each across a single ten episode run, and that might end up being the case here if we get a Season 30 making its debut later this year. But with also such a milestone season, that might not be on the way until next year. What are you hoping to see from the rest of South Park Season 29? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: CyberAgent Announces Business Alliance With Animation Studio MAPPA
content:
Media advertising company CyberAgent announced on Wednesday that it has entered into a business alliance agreement with animation studio MAPPA , and has acquired a stake in MHD Co., MAPPA 's parent company. The partnership will combine MAPPA 's animation production capabilities and CyberAgent 's media expertise to strengthen their ability to create anime and deliver it to audiences. The partnership will focus on the two companies' shared value of the "creator first" culture, rooted in their respect for the passion that creators bring to their craft. Through the partnership, the companies will explore collaboration from planning and production to broadcasting and streaming, games, merchandise, and events.

Along with the announcement, the two companies' executives have released statements regarding the partnership:

CyberAgent representative director and president Takahiro Yamauchi :

"We have entered into a partnership with MAPPA Co., Ltd. and invested in its parent company, MHD Co., Ltd. We have deep respect for anime culture that has been cultivated over many years, and for the passion that creators pour into each and every work. As fellow leaders of our generation in the industry, Mr. Otsuka and I adopt 'Creative First' as our shared value. By bringing CyberAgent 's expertise across anime, game, and media business operations, we want to realize multifaceted initiatives together for great stories to cross borders and reach audiences. We devote our full efforts from a long-term perspective to enhance the true value of Japan's anime worldwide."

MAPPA President and CEO Manabu Ōtsuka :

"We have always asked ourselves how best to create and deliver our works so that audiences can enjoy them more deeply. Along the way, we have come to realize how important it is to work closely with partners who bring different strengths and to think together, beyond the interests of any single company, about what would make the experience better for the people who enjoy our works. We are grateful that the team at CyberAgent shares these beliefs and sees the possibilities that can open up when our two companies work together, and this has led us to deepen our collaboration. We will continue to create with great care for quality and at the right pace, sharing the appeal of our works so that audiences around the world can enjoy them."

CyberAgent recently established a new creative hub called Canvas Kyoto in June, which aims to foster new creators and broaden the pool involved with the anime and game production, especially in Japan's Kansai region which includes Kyoto.

Cygames Pictures became a consolidated subsidiary of CyberAgent on February 27. Cygames Pictures was previously a subsidiary of CyberAgent 's subsidiary Cygames . Cygames Pictures changed its name to Cypic on April 6.

CyberAgent established Cygames in 2011, and the company has produced games such as Uma Musume Pretty Derby , Rage of Bahamut , and Granblue Fantasy . Cygames established an anime division in March 2015 and the anime production subsidiary Cygames Pictures in April 2016. The company has worked on anime productions inspired by its games including Uma Musume Pretty Derby , Rage of Bahamut Genesis , Rage of Bahamut: Virgin Soul , and Granblue Fantasy the Animation .

In April 2024, CyberAgent created in-house guidelines for its creators for using generative AI/large language models for images, aimed at avoiding violations of copyright law and highlighting that current generative AI cannot produce a usable end product as-is. Cygames founded its Cygames AI Studio in December.

CyberAgent established its AI Lab group in 2016, and it debuted its first large language model based on Japanese in May 2023. The company established an AI-focused business unit focused on game development named "Game AI Lab" in October 2023, as well as the "Animation AI Lab" business unit for animation production in the same month.

MAPPA is currently holding the MAPPA Expo 15th Anniversary exhibition at the Yurakucho Museum in Tokyo between September 16 and December 27. The exhibition will also travel to Fukuoka between January and March 2027.

MAPPA announced in February that it will absorb its sibling studio Contrail through a merger, assuming all rights and obligations.

Netflix formed a new strategic partnership with anime studio MAPPA in January. The new partnership makes Netflix the exclusive streamer for a number of future original anime titles from MAPPA , and allows the two companies to work together on these new projects in a more comprehensive way "from story development to merchandise." New titles from MAPPA will stream exclusively and simultaneously on Netflix worldwide.

title: 'Mashle: Sanma Taisou Shinkakusha Saishuu Shiken-hen' Reveals Additional Cast, Promo
content:
The official website of the Mashle ( Mashle: Magic and Muscles ) television anime revealed additional cast pair, a key visual and a promotional video for its third season on Wednesday. The new season is scheduled to premiere on January 10 at 12.00 a.m. on Tokyo MX, BS11, Gunma TV and Tochigi TV, followed by FBS Fukoka, Chukyo TV, Nagano Asahi, Okayama, Miyagi TV, Sapporo TV, Television Niigata and Chugoku.

Voice actors Souma Saitou ( Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e ) and Ryouta Suzuki ( Sakamoto Days ) are joining the cast as Domina Blowlive and Lévis Rosequartz, respectively.

Tomoya Tanaka ( Engage Kiss ) returns to direct the third season at A-1 Pictures . Yousuke Kuroda ( Boku no Hero Academia ) is handling series composition and penning the script. Chiaki Furuzumi ( Ore dake Level Up na Ken sub-character design) is designing the characters with Satoshi Motoyama ( Saigo ni Hitotsu dake Onegai shitemo Yoroshii deshou ka ) serving as sound director.

Mashle adapts Hajime Koumoto 's action comedy manga , which ran in Weekly Shounen Jump from January 2020 to July 2023. Shueisha published the 18th and final volume in October 2023.

VIZ Media simulpublished the manga in English and shipped the 18th and final volume in December 2024. Shueisha's Manga Plus platform also simulpublished the manga in English.

title: Elden Ring: Distant Tales Between Manga Ends in Next Chapter
content:
Haruichi 's Elden Ring: Distant Tales Between ( Elden Ring: Tōki Hazama no Monogatari ) comedy manga , based on Bandai Namco and FromSoftware 's Elden Ring game, announced on October 19 that it will end in its next chapter. The manga did not reveal when that next chapter will debut, and the manga's webpage says the next chapter's scheduled launch is "to be determined."

The manga will end in its third volume, which was slated to ship on December 4.

Yen Press licensed the series, and it describes the story:

These are the tales of the other inhabitants of the Lands Between. What if Roderika were to befriend the rest of the Roundtable Hold? What if the Blackguard went in search of a new delicacy other than prawns? What if one were to catch a glimpse of Rya's youth? The lives of those in the Lands Between, and the many possibilities and the differing worlds that unfolded for them in the distant past, are written here.

Haruichi ( Star Wars: Visions , Star Wars Leia, Princess of Alderaan manga series) debuted the omnibus collection of short stories in July 2024.

FromSoftware launched the original Elden Ring game for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and PC via Steam in February 2022. The game quickly surpassed 12 million units in sales worldwide in March 2022, and had overtaken Call of Duty: Vanguard as the best-selling game in the U.S. in the last 12 months ending in April 2022. The game's DLC expansion Shadow of the Erdtree launched in June 2024 for PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam . The base Elden Ring game is required for the expansion. The DLC crossed 5 million copies in sales within its first three days of launch.

The game received a version for Nintendo Switch 2 titled Elden Ring : Tarnished Edition that released on August 28, delayed from its 2025 release. The Switch 2 version includes content from the DLC expansion Shadow of the Erdtree . The game also features new armor and a new customization for Torrent's appearance.

Hidetaka Miyazaki ( Dark Souls , Dark Souls III , Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice ) and author George R. R. Martin ( Game of Thrones ) collaborated in creating the original Elden Ring game's world.

The game is inspiring a live-action Hollywood film adaptation that will premiere on March 3, 2028.

title: Sayaka Mogi's Happy Hypoxia Manga Ends
content:
Futabasha 's Web Action manga website released the 15th and final chapter of Sayaka Mogi 's Happy Hypoxia -Haiiro no Ko- (Happy Hypoxia -The Grey Child-) manga on Tuesday.

The manga centers on Miyuki, a woman who has undergone fertility treatment for eight years and has just finally given birth. At the hospital, she meets Mirei, another woman who has just given birth. She expresses that she doesn't like how her own child or other people's babies look, leading Miyuki to think that Mirei didn't want to have her child. At that moment, a fire starts and begins to engulf the hospital, forcing Miyuki to make a desperate choice.

Mogi launched the manga in Futabasha 's Web Action manga website in June 2025. Futabasha published the manga's second compiled book volume on May 28.

Mogi launched the Kuroneko Sensei to Hotsureta Kanja-tachi (The Black Cat Doctor and the Frayed Patients) manga in September 2025. Hayakawa Publishing released the manga's first volume on June 24.

Mogi's Girl, Meat Girl "interspecies coming-of-age sci-fi" manga recently ended on February 13. Mogi launched the manga in Asahi Shimbun Publications ' Nemuki+ magazine in February 2023.

Mogi launched her horror manga Pupa in the inaugural issue of Comic Earth Star magazine in 2011, and ended it in December 2013. Earth Star Entertainment published five volumes for the manga. The manga inspired a 12-episode series of television anime shorts that premiered in January 2014.

Mogi launched the Red Riding Hood's Wolf Apprentice manga in Kodansha 's Bessatsu Shōnen Magazine in September 2017. Mogi published the end of the "first part" of the manga in December 2018, and announced that she would self-publish the rest of the manga. Kodansha published the manga's third compiled book volume in February 2019. Kodansha USA Publishing published the manga in English digitally, and it released the third volume in September 2019.

Mogi published the first volume of the Red Riding Hood's Wolf Apprentice: Final Testament to the Moon ( Akazukin no Ōkami Deshi - Tsuki e no Tsuigon ), the sequel manga of Red Riding Hood's Wolf Apprentice , at the Comitia dōjinshi event in Tokyo in May 2019. The digital version debuted in July 2019. Glacier Bay Books licensed the manga and published the first volume in English in print in May 2022. Digital manga service Azuki ( now Omoi ) added the manga in August 2022.
